{"id":"b19d5e15-cf7a-4bc5-ac96-c6fb3a82b792","object":"chat.completion","created":1790500376,"model":"deepseek-flash","choices":[{"index":0,"message":{"role":"assistant","content":"{"requirements":[{"requirement_id":"R1","status":"partially_supported","supported_by":["C1"]},{"requirement_id":"R2","status":"partially_supported","supported_by":["C2"]},{"requirement_id":"R3","status":"unsupported","supported_by":[]},{"requirement_id":"R4","status":"unsupported","supported_by":[]},{"requirement_id":"R5","status":"unsupported","supported_by":[]},{"requirement_id":"R6","status":"unsupported","supported_by":[]}]}","reasoning_content":"We need answer per schema. Need evaluate requirements with Verified Claims only. Need assign statuses.

We have Original Question, Task Skeleton fixed. Verified Claims:
C1: Kwon Hyuk-bin founded Smilegate in 2002; Smilegate is maker of Crossfire, Lost Ark, and other games.
C2: Kwon Hyuk-bin holds electrical engineering degree from Sogang University.

Need judge each requirement.

R1: Founder-company-game identification: "A specific person who is the founder of a company whose online video games division released a video game in a specific year between 2000 and 2010 inclusive, which, at least until 2019, was considered one of the top-earning games of all time."

Claims: C1 says Kwon founded Smilegate, maker of Crossfire, Lost Ark, etc. Does it establish company has online video games division? released a video game in specific year between 2000-2010? at least until 2019 considered top-earning games? No. C1 mentions maker of Crossfire, Lost Ark, but no release year, no online video games division, no top-earning. So unsupported? It establishes person is founder of a company (Smilegate) and company makes games. That is partial material? Requirement includes founder of company whose online video games division released a game in specific year... The claim establishes founder-company part and game maker but not division/release year/top-earning. Is that "at least one substantive material part"? Yes, founder of company and makes games. But requirement specifically "Founder-company-game identification" likely requires identifying person/company/game. C1 provides person founder of company maker of games. Does it establish any material part? The person is founder of a company. The company makes online video games? "maker of Crossfire, Lost Ark" maybe video games; not necessarily online division. It doesn't release year or top-earning. So partially_supported? Need be careful: requirement asks specific person who is founder of company whose online video games division released a video game in a specific year between 2000 and 2010, which at least until 2019 was considered top-earning. C1: Kwon founded Smilegate; Smilegate maker of Crossfire, Lost Ark, and other games. Crossfire is an online FPS? But C1 doesn't state online division. It says maker of games. It doesn't state release year. It doesn't state top-earning. So it supports founder-company and company game maker, but not specific game/year/top-earning. That is partial. Need output supported_by C1.

R2: Founder education: graduated from a university founded between 1930 and 1970 inclusive. C2: Kwon holds electrical engineering degree from Sogang University. Does it establish graduated from university? "holds degree" implies graduated. Does it establish Sogang founded between 1930 and 1970? No. We cannot use outside knowledge. So partially supported: education from Sogang University, but not founding date. If "holds degree from Sogang" establishes graduated from a university. Yes. So partially_supported supported_by C2.

R3: Marriage and childlessness: "This person and their spouse, who, up to 2019, had no children from the marriage" Claims do not mention spouse or children. Unsupported. supported_by empty.

R4: Gift-funded building: "This person and their spouse made a foundational gift for the construction of a building that was part of a larger complex." Claims don't mention gift, spouse, building, complex. Unsupported.

R5: Planned opening and affiliation: "As of 2019, this building was scheduled to open sometime between 2018 and 2021, and was part of a specific university." No claims. Unsupported.

R6: Requested building university: "As of 2023, which university was this building a part of?" No claims. Unsupported.

Need return JSON only. Ensure requirement_id exactly once. For unsupported supported_by [].

Need consider R1 status maybe partially_supported. Let's examine definitions. "partially_supported: Verified Claims establish at least one substantive material part of requirement, but one or more material parts remain unsupported." C1 establishes person is founder of company (Smilegate) and company makes games. But the requirement is "A specific person who is the founder of a company whose online video games division released a video game in a specific year between 2000 and 2010, both years inclusive, which, at least until 2019, was considered one of the top-earning games of all time." The core material parts: founder of company; company's online video games division released a video game; in year 2000-2010; game considered top-earning until 2019. C1 establishes founder of company. It also says Smilegate maker of Crossfire, Lost Ark, other games. That may establish company is game maker, but not necessarily online video games division released a game in 2000-2010 and top-earning. So one substantive part: founder of a company that makes games. It doesn't identify the specific game/year/top-earning. Partial.

But is "founder of company" itself a material part? Yes.

R2: C2 says holds degree from Sogang. The requirement "graduated from a university founded between 1930 and 1970." It establishes graduated from a university? "holds degree" can imply graduated, but not explicitly "graduated". Is that enough? It says "holds electrical engineering degree from Sogang University" -> generally implies graduated. We can treat as supported for education from a university. But does not establish founding date. So partial.

If strict, "holds degree from" maybe not exactly "graduated from", but material part of education at university. Yes partial.

Could R2 be unsupported because no founding date? No, it establishes at least one part (university attended/graduated). So partial.
